guide.closed: The guide has ended. You can show it again from {{settings}}, under “{{guide}}”.
guide.example:
I'd like to try the whole flow of working with alpacawork.
Make an HTML page that says "Hello" in two different fonts, and ask me which one is better.
guide.moreExample: Actually, I'd like one more version to compare.

say.accept: If it's fine, finish the task with this button ({{finish}}).
say.anotherRepository: To use another repository, open this, choose “{{create}}”, and pick that repository as its working folder.
say.answer: Choosing an answer puts it in the box below. Sending it makes it your answer.
say.apps: You can also install alpacawork as an app on this computer, or open it from your phone. The steps are in {{settings}}, under “{{apps}}”.
say.conversation: The conversation with the front-desk AI is disposable. When it piles up, open it and use “{{clear}}”; ask for anything worth keeping to be made a task.
say.label: This label tells the AI which task you mean, as a hint. Without it, the AI works it out from the conversation.
say.more: You can keep asking after a report. Try having it make one more version to compare.
say.question: Your turn. Press this row to open the question.
say.received: The front-desk AI (the coordinator) has it. It takes a moment to hand it to an AI.
say.result: A report came. Press this row to open it.
say.sendAgain: Write what you want done here and send it.
say.stop: To stop the AI, choose “{{stop}}” here, or ask in the input. You can also ask there to change settings or add a model.
say.unassigned: No AI is on this task yet. Open the row and ask in the input to start it.
say.working: This is a task. The AI on it works on it, and moves it to “{{section}}” when a question or report comes.

pending.long: A new instruction arrived. Waiting for the owner to give a new report estimate.

timeView.axisAbsent: The time view is not saved on this device. It loads when the connection is back.
timeView.help: Scroll sideways to move through time. Zoom with ctrl (⌘) + wheel, a pinch, or two fingers. Double-click the time scale to see everything. Point at a line (tap on a phone) for details. Keys: + − 0 N; press → on a title to read its lines in turn.

welcome.lead: A place to hand work to a team of AIs.

picture.listed: They're listed. Your turn comes under “{{section}}”
picture.split: The front-desk AI turns it into tasks, places an AI on each and runs them
